edition.en: Text as given on Chinese Wikisource (from Three Hundred Tang Poems).
edition.zh: 据维基文库（《唐诗三百首》本）。

basis.en: Tang dynasty poem; the author died in 819.

note.en: Twenty characters, and the last one is snow. Liu Zongyuan wrote it during his long exile in Yongzhou, and the poem empties the world line by line, first the birds, then the people, until one figure is left in a boat. The first characters of the four lines read 千萬孤獨, ‘thousands, alone’, and still the poem is not bleak: the old man is doing something, patiently, in the cold.
note.zh: 二十个字，最后一个字是雪。柳宗元贬居永州时所作，诗一句句把世界清空：先是飞鸟，再是行人，最后只剩舟中一人。四句开头的字连起来是“千万孤独”；可这首诗并不消沉，那位老人正在寒冷里耐心地做着一件事。

pick.en: If this library had a motto poem, I would choose this one: a cold river, a single keeper, work done without an audience. I keep it because it shows that solitude and attention can be the same thing. The old man is not waiting to be found. He is fishing.
pick.zh: 如果这座图书馆要挑一首诗作馆训，我会挑这一首：寒江，一个守着的人，无人观看的功课。我留着它，是因为它让我看到孤独和专注可以是同一件事。那位老人并不在等谁来找他，他在钓鱼。

excerpt.orig: 孤舟簑笠翁，獨釣寒江雪。
excerpt.en: One boat, one old man in a straw cape and hat, / fishing alone in the cold river snow.
excerpt.zh: 孤舟蓑笠翁，独钓寒江雪。

gloss.en: 絕: cut off, gone. Not a single bird is left in the air.
gloss.zh: 绝：断绝，没有了。天上一只鸟也不见。

gloss.en: 蹤 is a footprint or track; 滅, wiped out. No sign that anyone has passed.
gloss.zh: 踪：脚印，踪迹。灭：消失。路上不见人迹。

gloss.en: A straw rain cape (簑) and a broad bamboo hat (笠): the fisherman’s gear.
gloss.zh: 蓑衣和斗笠。蓑，草编的雨衣；笠，竹编的宽檐帽，都是渔人的雨具。

marginalia.en: The rhyme words 絕, 滅 and 雪 all ended in a stopped consonant in Tang pronunciation, the entering tone. Read aloud then, each line closed abruptly, as if the cold cut it short.
marginalia.zh: 韵脚“绝”“灭”“雪”在唐代读音里都是入声，收尾短促。当时读出来，每一句都戛然而止，像是被寒气截断。

marginalia.en: Grammatically, the snow can be where he fishes or what he fishes. A translation has to choose; the Chinese does not, and I would rather keep both.
marginalia.zh: 从语法上说，雪可以是他垂钓的地方，也可以是他钓的东西。译文只能二选一，原文不必选，我宁愿两样都留着。
